title: eDiscovery download account (ME3 auto-download)
desc: eDiscovery Standard (ME3) tenants require a browser sign-in to download exports. Registering a dedicated non-MFA service account here enables automatic download with no sign-in prompt. (MFA accounts still require manual approval in the window after auto-fill.) The password is encrypted with Windows DPAPI and stored only in this profile on this PC.

messages.missingInput: Enter the service account and password.
messages.saved: Saved — the next ME3 download will run automatically with no sign-in prompt.
